basic_details.job_title: DCPU Karur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, Office Assistant Posts
basic_details.post_name: Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, Office Assistant

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is that the applicant's age should not exceed 42 years of age.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior assistant cum record clerk: Must have passed 10th Standard (SSLC) from a recognized board / its equivalent. | office assistant: Must have passed 8th Standard from a recognized board.

how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form from the provided link.
Read all instructions carefully before filling out the application form.
Fill in the applicant's name in capital letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age, native district, marital status, address for communication, and contact details.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of supporting documents for educational qualifications and work experience certificates as applicable.
Verify that all details and enclosures are complete to avoid summary rejection.
Send the completed application form to the designated address before 15-10-2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications without relevant supporting documents will be summarily rejected without any prior information. The posts are on a purely temporary, consolidated-pay contract basis at the Juvenile Justice Board, Karur. Candidates must ensure they do not exceed 42 years of age. The application period closes on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is DCPU Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DCPU Karur Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification inviting offline applications for 2 temporary contract posts of Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant at the Juvenile Justice Board, Karur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DCPU Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 vacancy for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and 1 vacancy for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th Standard (SSLC) from a recognized board or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 8th Standard from a recognized board.
